<!-- For detailed instructions, see:
     https://worldbank.github.io/devPTIpack/articles/build-pti-3-metadata.html -->

## What this step does

Step 3 assembles your indicator data into the metadata workbook that the app reads.
It takes: (a) a metadata skeleton Excel defining your indicator dictionary, and
(b) one or more data tables produced by Steps 1, 2, or your own analysis — and
merges them into `app-data/metadata-user.xlsx`.

## Required data structure

Each data table you provide must have one row per polygon at the relevant admin
level, keyed by `admin<N>Pcod`, with one column per indicator. Column names must
match the `var_code` values in your metadata skeleton's `metadata` sheet.

## Load your indicator data

```{r}
#| message: false
library(devPTIpack)

# Option A: from a Step 2 zonal stats output
# adm2_values <- readxl::read_xlsx("sample-data/zonal-stats-adm2.xlsx")

# Option B: directly from your own data file
# adm2_values <- readr::read_csv("sample-data/my-indicators.csv")

# Default: use the bundled Rwanda sample workbook directly (no patch needed)
mtdt_path <- "sample-data/sample-metadata-adm1-adm2.xlsx"
inp_dta   <- fct_template_reader(mtdt_path)
names(inp_dta)
```

## Merge indicator data into the metadata workbook

Use `pti_patch_admin_sheet()` to merge each data table into the correct admin
sheet. Column names in your data must match `var_code` values in the skeleton's
`metadata` sheet — edit the skeleton's `metadata` sheet to declare them first.
Do **not** edit the admin data sheets directly.

```{r}
#| eval: false
# IMPORTANT: Edit the Excel skeleton's 'metadata' sheet to declare
# var_codes matching your column names — do NOT edit the admin data
# sheets directly.
pti_patch_admin_sheet(
  mtdt_path   = "sample-data/metadata-skeleton.xlsx",
  admin_level = "admin2_District",
  values      = adm2_values,
  pcod_col    = "admin2Pcod",
  output_path = "app-data/metadata-user.xlsx"
)
```

## Validate against your shapefile

```{r}
validate_metadata(
  shp_path  = "app-data/shapes.rds",
  mtdt_path = mtdt_path
)

# Visual inspection via standalone Shiny app -- uncomment and re-source
# this file interactively when you want the visual pass.
# shp_dta <- readRDS("app-data/shapes.rds")
# app_validate_metadata(shp_dta = shp_dta, inp_dta = inp_dta)
```

## Stage the workbook for Step 5

`compile_pti_data()` (Step 5) merges every intermediate metadata file
under `app-data/`. Copy the validated user workbook to its canonical
location now:

```{r}
dir.create("app-data", showWarnings = FALSE)
file.copy(
  from      = mtdt_path,
  to        = "app-data/metadata-user.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```
